verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline dominant as a left-to-right banner, but the subhead is broken into four narrow lines with 'makeover' on a line of its own, and the CTA underline sits far below 'Shop the deal', cut loose from its label. B inverts the hierarchy: 'Shop the deal' is blown up to the largest element across three lines while the headline is shrunk small and off-centre, with dead space on the left, and the underline is detached from the text.
